sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN BE.`Unit Price.USD` IS NOT NULL
            THEN BE.`Unit Price.USD`
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS AssetValue,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) <= 0
                AND NOT (
                    PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS UnsupportedAssets,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) > 0
                AND
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) <= 92
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS SupportEnding3Months,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) > 92
                AND
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) <= 183
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS SupportEnding6Months,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) > 183
                AND
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) <= 365
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS SupportEnding12Months,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) > 365
                AND
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) <= 730
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS SupportEnding24Months,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN
                BE.`Impact` IN (
                    '1-Extensive/Widespread',
                    '2-Significant/Large'
                )
                AND
                DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    CASE
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                        THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                        ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    END
                ) <= 0
                AND NOT (
                    PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS CriticalUnsupportedAssets,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) = 0
        THEN 0
        ELSE
        (
            100 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN
                        DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CASE
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                                ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                            END
                        ) <= 0
                        AND NOT (
                            PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL
                            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                            AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                        )
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
            +
            80 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN
                        DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CASE
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                                ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                            END
                        ) BETWEEN 1 AND 92
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
            +
            60 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN
                        DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CASE
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                                ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                            END
                        ) BETWEEN 93 AND 183
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
            +
            40 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN
                        DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CASE
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                                ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                            END
                        ) BETWEEN 184 AND 365
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
            +
            20 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN
                        DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CASE
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                                WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                                THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                                ELSE PMV.`EndOfLife`
                            END
                        ) BETWEEN 366 AND 730
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
        ) / COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`)
    END AS OverallRiskScore

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
        AssetInstanceId
    FROM `AST:AssetPeople`
    WHERE
        `PersonRole` IN (
            'Managed by',
            'Supported by',
            'Owned by'
        )
        AND `Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
    GROUP BY
        AssetInstanceId
) AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId

LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
    ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
    AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
    AND (
        BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
        )
    )

WHERE
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'Deployed'
    AND BE.`Installation Date` <= CurrentDate()
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True'
        OR AP.AssetInstanceId IS NOT NULL
    )

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT 
  BE.`Model Number` + ' ' + BE.`Version Number` AS AssetType,
  CASE
WHEN PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL AND (PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL) AND PMV.EndOfExtendedSupport IS NULL THEN 'EOL Not Defined'
WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.EndOfExtendedSupport IS NULL AND PMV.EndOfSecuritySupport IS NULL THEN 'EOS Not Defined'
WHEN ((DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL)  AND (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) < 0 OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL) AND (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) < 0 OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL)) THEN 'Support Ended'
WHEN ((DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <= $CloseToEOSDays) OR (PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL)) AND (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) <= $CloseToEOSDays OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL) THEN 'Supported but Close to EOS'
WHEN (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL) AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <= 0 AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) > 0 THEN 'On Extended Support'
WHEN DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) >=0 THEN 'Supported but EOL'
ELSE 'Fully Supported'
END AS LifeCycleExpiry,
Count(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS  CountOfAssets
FROM
`AST:BaseElement` BE
  LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
     LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
     ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version` OR (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
Where 
BE.`Data Set Id` IN ('BMC.ASSET')
and BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
AND (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True' OR AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio))
AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN ($AssetLifeCycleStatus)
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
Group By
AssetType,LifeCycleExpiry
order by CountOfAssets desc
limit 200

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
/* Assets installed while still in support */

SELECT
    DATE(BE.`Installation Date`) AS EventDate,
    COUNT(BE.`Reconciliation Identity`) AS ManagedAssetsChange,
    COUNT(BE.`Reconciliation Identity`) AS InSupportChange,
    0 AS OutOfSupportChange
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
    ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
    AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
    AND (
        BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
        )
    )
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    --AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Installation Date` IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP1
            WHERE AP1.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND AP1.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
              AND AP1.`PersonRole` IN (
                  'Managed by',
                  'Supported by',
                  'Owned by'
              )
        )
    )
    AND (
        (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL
        )
    )
GROUP BY
    DATE(BE.`Installation Date`)

UNION ALL

/* Assets already out of support when installed */

SELECT
    DATE(BE.`Installation Date`) AS EventDate,
    COUNT(BE.`Reconciliation Identity`) AS ManagedAssetsChange,
    0 AS InSupportChange,
    COUNT(BE.`Reconciliation Identity`) AS OutOfSupportChange
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
    ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
    AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
    AND (
        BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
        )
    )
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    --AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Installation Date` IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP2
            WHERE AP2.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND AP2.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
              AND AP2.`PersonRole` IN (
                  'Managed by',
                  'Supported by',
                  'Owned by'
              )
        )
    )
    AND (
        (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` < BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` < BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` < BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` < BE.`Installation Date`
        )
    )
GROUP BY
    DATE(BE.`Installation Date`)

UNION ALL

/* Assets that reached support expiry after installation */

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE(PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`)
        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE(PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`)
        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE(PMV.`EndOfSupport`)
        ELSE DATE(PMV.`EndOfLife`)
    END AS EventDate,
    0 AS ManagedAssetsChange,
    0 - COUNT(BE.`Reconciliation Identity`) AS InSupportChange,
    COUNT(BE.`Reconciliation Identity`) AS OutOfSupportChange
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
    ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
    AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
    AND (
        BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
        )
    )
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    --AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Installation Date` IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP3
            WHERE AP3.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND AP3.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
              AND AP3.`PersonRole` IN (
                  'Managed by',
                  'Supported by',
                  'Owned by'
              )
        )
    )
    AND (
        (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
        OR (
            PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfLife` >= BE.`Installation Date`
        )
    )
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE(PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`)
        WHEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE(PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`)
        WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
            THEN DATE(PMV.`EndOfSupport`)
        ELSE DATE(PMV.`EndOfLife`)
    END

UNION ALL


/* Projected return to support following scheduled remediation */

SELECT
    DATE(RM.RemediationDate) AS EventDate,
    0 AS ManagedAssetsChange,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RM.Instance) AS InSupportChange,
    0 - COUNT(DISTINCT RM.Instance) AS OutOfSupportChange
FROM (
    SELECT
        BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
        MIN(CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) AS RemediationDate
    FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
    INNER JOIN `AST:CMDB Associations` CA
        ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CA.`Request ID02`
        AND CA.`Request Type01` = 'Infrastructure Change'
    INNER JOIN `CHG:Infrastructure Change` CHG
        ON CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID` = CA.`Request ID01`
    LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
        ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
        AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
        AND (
            BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
            OR (
                PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
                AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
            )
        )
    WHERE
        ${IncludeUpcomingRemediation:singlequote} = 'true'
        AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
        AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
        AND BE.`Installation Date` <= CurrentDate()
        --AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
        AND (
            BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
            OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        )
        AND (
            ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP4
                WHERE AP4.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP4.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
                  AND AP4.`PersonRole` IN (
                      'Managed by',
                      'Supported by',
                      'Owned by'
                  )
            )
        )
        AND (
            (
                PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
                AND DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
                ) <= 0
            )
            OR (
                PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                AND DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                ) <= 0
            )
            OR (
                PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                AND DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                ) <= 0
            )
            OR (
                PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
                AND DATEDIFF(
                    'day',
                    CurrentDate(),
                    PMV.`EndOfLife`
                ) <= 0
            )
        )
        AND CHG.`Description` LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
        AND CHG.`Change Request Status` NOT IN (
            'Cancelled',
            'Completed',
            'Closed'
        )
        AND DATEDIFF(
            'day',
            CurrentDate(),
            CHG.`Scheduled End Date`
        ) > 0
    GROUP BY
        BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
) RM
GROUP BY
    DATE(RM.RemediationDate)
ORDER BY
    1 ASC

SELECT
Date(PMV.EndOfLife) as LifeCycleDate,
Count(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS  AssetsEndOfLife
FROM
`AST:BaseElement` BE
  INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
     LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
     ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
Where 
BE.`Data Set Id` IN ('BMC.ASSET')
and BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN ($AssetLifeCycleStatus)
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')
Group By
LifeCycleDate

SELECT
Date(PMV.EndOfSupport) as LifeCycleDate,
Count(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS  AssetsEndOfSupport
FROM
`AST:BaseElement` BE
  INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
     LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
     ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
Where 
BE.`Data Set Id` IN ('BMC.ASSET')
and BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')

panels.description: Detailed list of Assets by remediation status including the host where the software or device may be  hosted on. Also includes CRQ related information if applicable

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
    BE.`Name` AS AssetName,
    BE.`Short Description` AS AssetDescription,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
    BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
    BE.`Serial Number` AS SerialNumber,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` AS AssetLifecycleStatus,
    BE.`Model Number` AS Product,
    BE.`MarketVersion` AS Version,
    BE.`Manufacturer Name+` AS Manufacturer,
    BE.`Installation Date` AS InstallationDate,
    BE.`LastScanDate` AS LastScanDate,
    PMV.`EndOfLife` AS EndOfLife,
    PMV.`EndOfSupport` AS EndOfSupport,
    PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` AS EndOfExtendedSupport,
    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` AS EndOfSecuritySupport,
    MAX(BC.`Name`) AS HostName,
    MAX(BC.`CapabilityList`) AS CapabilityList,
    MAX(BRP.`ClassId`) AS HostRelationship,
    MAX(CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID`) AS CRQNumber,
    CASE
        WHEN
            (
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    ) <= 0
                )
            )
            AND SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN CHG.`Description` LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
                        AND CHG.`Change Request Status` NOT IN (
                            'Cancelled',
                            'Completed',
                            'Closed'
                        )
                        AND DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CHG.`Scheduled End Date`
                        ) > 0
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) > 0
        THEN 'Expired Upcoming CRQ'

        WHEN
            (
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    ) <= 0
                )
            )
            AND SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN CHG.`Description` LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
                        AND CHG.`Change Request Status` <> 'Cancelled'
                        AND DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CHG.`Scheduled End Date`
                        ) <= 0
                        AND DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CHG.`Scheduled End Date`
                        ) >= 0 - $PastCRQDays
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) > 0
        THEN 'Expired Past CRQ'

        WHEN
            (
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                    ) <= 0
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    ) <= 0
                )
            )
            AND SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN CHG.`Description` LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
                        AND CHG.`Change Request Status` NOT IN (
                            'Cancelled',
                            'Completed',
                            'Closed'
                        )
                        AND DATEDIFF(
                            'day',
                            CurrentDate(),
                            CHG.`Scheduled End Date`
                        ) > 0
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 0
        THEN 'Expired No Upcoming CRQ'

        WHEN
            (
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
                    ) > 0
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
                    ) <= $CloseToEOSDays
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                    ) > 0
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
                    ) <= $CloseToEOSDays
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                    ) > 0
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfSupport`
                    ) <= $CloseToEOSDays
                )
                OR
                (
                    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
                    AND PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NOT NULL
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    ) > 0
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        PMV.`EndOfLife`
                    ) <= $CloseToEOSDays
                )
            )
        THEN 'Close to EOS'

        ELSE 'Other Assets'
    END AS AssetView
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`AND AP.`PersonRole` IN (
        'Managed by',
        'Supported by',
        'Owned by'
    )

LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
    ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
    AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
    AND (
        BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
        )
    )

LEFT OUTER JOIN `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseRelationship` BRP
    ON BE.`Instance Id` = BRP.`Destination.InstanceId`

LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:ComputerSystem` BC
    ON BRP.`Source.InstanceId` = BC.`Instance Id`
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = BC.`Data Set Id`

LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:CMDB Associations` CA
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CA.`Request ID02`
    AND CA.`Request Type01` = 'Infrastructure Change'

LEFT OUTER JOIN `CHG:Infrastructure Change` CHG
    ON CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID` = CA.`Request ID01`

WHERE
    AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
    
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )

GROUP BY
    BE.`Name`,
    BE.`Short Description`,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName`,
    BE.`Class Id`,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity`,
    BE.`Serial Number`,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus`,
    BE.`Model Number`,
    BE.`MarketVersion`,
    BE.`Manufacturer Name+`,
    BE.`Installation Date`,
    BE.`LastScanDate`,
    PMV.`EndOfLife`,
    PMV.`EndOfSupport`,
    PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`,
    PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
/* Assets that are out of support without an active upcoming remediation CRQ */

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS `NotScheduled`,
    MAX(${SmartITURL:singlequote}) AS SmartITLink

FROM (
    SELECT
        BE.`Reconciliation Identity`

    FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

    INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
        ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`

    LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
        ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name`
        AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer`
        AND (
            BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
            OR (
                PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
                AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
            )
        )

    LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:CMDB Associations` CA
        ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CA.`Request ID02`
        AND CA.`Request Type01` = 'Infrastructure Change'

    LEFT OUTER JOIN `CHG:Infrastructure Change` CHG
        ON CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID` = CA.`Request ID01`

    WHERE
        BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
        AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
        AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
        AND AP.`PersonRole` IN (
            'Managed by',
            'Supported by',
            'Owned by'
        )
        AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
        AND BE.`Installation Date` <= CurrentDate()
        AND (
            BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
            OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        )
        AND (
            DATEDIFF(
                'day',
                CurrentDate(),
                PMV.`EndOfLife`
            ) <= 0
            OR PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL
        )
        AND (
            DATEDIFF(
                'day',
                CurrentDate(),
                PMV.`EndOfSupport`
            ) <= 0
            OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
        )
        AND (
            DATEDIFF(
                'day',
                CurrentDate(),
                PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
            ) <= 0
            OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
        )
        AND (
            DATEDIFF(
                'day',
                CurrentDate(),
                PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
            ) <= 0
            OR PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
        )
        AND NOT (
            PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
            AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL
        )

    GROUP BY
        BE.`Reconciliation Identity`

    HAVING
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN CHG.`Description`
                    LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
                    AND CHG.`Change Request Status` NOT IN (
                        'Cancelled',
                        'Completed',
                        'Closed'
                    )
                    AND DATEDIFF(
                        'day',
                        CurrentDate(),
                        CHG.`Scheduled End Date`
                    ) > 0
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) = 0
) NS

/* Scheduled For Remediation */
SELECT 
          COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS `Scheduled`

FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:BaseElement` BE   
     INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
       INNER JOIN `AST:CMDB Associations` CA
       ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CA.`Request ID02`
         INNER JOIN `CHG:Infrastructure Change` CHG
         ON CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID` = CA.`Request ID01`
           LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
           ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` 
           AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
           OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL
            )
    )

             LEFT OUTER JOIN `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseRelationship` BRP
             ON ( BE.`Instance Id` = BRP.`Destination.InstanceId`)
               LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:ComputerSystem` BC
               ON (BRP.`Source.InstanceId`  =  BC.`Instance Id`) AND ( BE.`Data Set Id`  =  BC.`Data Set Id` )

WHERE
  BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
  AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus  = 'Deployed'
  AND BE.`Installation Date` <= CurrentDate()
  AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
  AND CA.`Request Type01` = 'Infrastructure Change'
  AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
  AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
  AND (BRP.`Source.ClassId` = 'BMC_COMPUTERSYSTEM' OR BRP.`Source.ClassId`IS NULL)
  AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
    AND NOT (PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) >=0
  AND CHG.Description  LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
  AND NOT (CHG.`Change Request Status` IN ('Cancelled','Completed','Closed'))
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) > 0
  AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')

SELECT 
          COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS `Failed`

FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:BaseElement` BE
     INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
       INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`AST:CMDB Associations` CA
       ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CA.`Request ID02` 
         INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`CHG:Infrastructure Change` CHG
         ON CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID` = CA.`Request ID01`
           LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
           ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version`
            

WHERE
  BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
  AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus  = 'Deployed'
  AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
  AND CA.`Request Type01` = 'Infrastructure Change'
  AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)

  AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
    AND NOT (PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) < 0
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) >= -180
  AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')

SELECT

  AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
  AND (BRP.`Source.ClassId` = 'BMC_COMPUTERSYSTEM' OR BRP.`Source.ClassId`IS NULL)
  AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
    AND NOT (PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) >=0
  AND CHG.Description  LIKE '%' + ${CRQKeyword} + '%'
  AND NOT (CHG.`Change Request Status` IN ('Cancelled','Completed','Closed'))
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) > 0
  AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')

/* Failed Remediation */ 
SELECT 


CASE WHEN $AssetsUnderManagement = 0 THEN 0
     ELSE
          COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) * 100.0 / $AssetsUnderManagement 
   END AS `Failed`

FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:BaseElement` BE
     INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
       INNER JOIN `AST:CMDB Associations` CA
       ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = CA.`Request ID02` 
         INNER JOIN `CHG:Infrastructure Change` CHG
         ON CHG.`Infrastructure Change ID` = CA.`Request ID01`
           LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
           ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version` OR (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
            

WHERE
  BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
  AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'Deployed'
  AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
  AND CA.`Request Type01` = 'Infrastructure Change'
  AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
  AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
  AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
    AND NOT (PMV.`EndOfLife` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport` IS NULL)
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) < 0
  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), CHG.`Scheduled End Date`) >= -180
  AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')

SELECT
          COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) * 100.0 / $AssetsUnderManagement  AS `Supported`
FROM 
          `AR System Schema`.`AST:BaseElement` BE
          INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP
          ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
             ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version` OR (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
WHERE      
     BE.`Data Set Id`  = 'BMC.ASSET'
     AND BE.UserDisplayObjectName IN ($AssetType) 
     AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
     AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
     AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN ($AssetLifeCycleStatus)
     AND (DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) >= 0 OR DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) >= 0 OR DATEDIFF('day',currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) >= 0)
     AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')

SELECT 
          COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) * 100.0 / $AssetsUnderManagement AS `MissingEOS`
FROM 
          `AR System Schema`.`AST:BaseElement` BE
          INNER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP
          ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
             LEFT OUTER JOIN `AR System Schema`.`PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
             ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version` OR (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
WHERE 
   BE.`Data Set Id`  = 'BMC.ASSET'
   AND BE.UserDisplayObjectName  IN ($AssetType)
   AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL 
   AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL
   AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
   AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
   AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN ($AssetLifeCycleStatus)
   AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No')

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT 
BE.`Name` AS  AssetName,
BE.`Short Description` AS AssetDescription,
BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
BE.AssetLifecycleStatus AS AssetStatus,
BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
CASE
WHEN PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL AND (PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL) AND PMV.EndOfExtendedSupport IS NULL THEN 'EOL Not Defined'
WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.EndOfExtendedSupport IS NULL THEN 'EOS Not Defined'
WHEN (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL)  AND (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) < 0 OR PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL) AND (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) < 0 OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL) THEN 'Support Ended'
WHEN (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <= 0 OR PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL) AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) < 0 AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) > 0 THEN 'On Extended Support'
WHEN ((DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) <= $CloseToEOSDays) OR (PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL)) AND (DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`) <= $CloseToEOSDays OR PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL) THEN 'Supported but Close to EOS'
WHEN DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfLife`) <=0  AND DATEDIFF('day', currentDate(), PMV.`EndOfSupport`) >=0 THEN 'Supported but EOL'
ELSE 'Fully Supported'
END AS LifeCycleExpiry,
CASE
WHEN PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL AND (PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL) THEN PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL THEN PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
WHEN PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL AND NOT (PMV.`EndOfLife`IS NULL) THEN PMV.`EndOfLife`
WHEN NOT (PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` IS NULL) AND PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` > PMV.`EndOfSupport` THEN PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`
WHEN NOT (PMV.`EndOfSupport` IS NULL) THEN PMV.`EndOfSupport`
ELSE PMV.`EndOfSecuritySupport`
END AS SupportExpiryDate,
BE.`EndOfLife`
FROM
`AST:BaseElement` BE
  INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
     ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
       LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
       ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version` OR (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
WHERE 
BE.`Data Set Id` IN ('BMC.ASSET')
AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'Deployed'
and BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
AND AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
AND AP.`PersonRole` IN ('Managed by','Supported by', 'Owned by')
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` is NULL OR BE.`Mark As Deleted`= 'No')
AND ($ObsolescenceState = 'All' OR LifeCycleExpiry = $ObsolescenceState)
group by 
AssetName,
AssetDescription,
AssetType,
Class,
AssetStatus,
Instance,
LifeCycleExpiry,
SupportExpiryDate,
BE.EndOfLife
ORDER BY LifeCycleExpiry, BE.Name
